variables.attention: {% set ns = namespace(l=[], b=[], s=[], o=[]) %}{% set b = states('sensor.any_low_battery') %}{% if b not in ['none', 'unknown', 'unavailable', ''] %}{% for e in b.split(', ') %}{% set ns.b = ns.b + [e if e.startswith('+') else ((state_attr(e, 'friendly_name') or e) | replace(' Battery', '')) ~ ' ' ~ (states(e) | float(0) | round(0) | int) ~ '%'] %}{% endfor %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + ['Batteries to replace: ' ~ ns.b | join(', ')] %}{% endif %}{% set s = states('sensor.any_safety_sensor_silent') %}{% if s not in ['none', 'unknown', 'unavailable', ''] %}{% for e in s.split(', ') %}{% set ns.s = ns.s + [state_attr(e, 'friendly_name') or e] %}{% endfor %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + ['Not reporting: ' ~ ns.s | join(', ')] %}{% endif %}{% set lo = states('sensor.lighting_left_on') %}{% if lo not in ['none', 'unknown', 'unavailable', ''] %}{% for e in lo.split(', ') %}{% set ns.o = ns.o + [state_attr(e, 'friendly_name') or e] %}{% endfor %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + ['Lights on: ' ~ ns.o | join(', ')] %}{% endif %}{% if is_state('binary_sensor.climate_health_risk', 'on') %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + ['Damp, health or air-quality risk: see Home'] %}{% endif %}{{ ns.l }}
variables.energy: {% set m = states('input_number.energy_yesterday_meters') | float(0) %}{% set t = states('input_number.energy_yesterday') | float(0) %}{% set a = states('input_number.energy_yesterday_ac') | float(0) %}{% if m > 0 %}Yesterday the metered devices used {{ t }} kWh{{ ', the ACs ' ~ (100 * a / t) | round(0) | int ~ '% of it' if t > 0 and a > 0 else '' }}.{% endif %}

variables.message: {{ (attention | join('\n') if attention else 'Nothing needs attention.') ~ ('\n' ~ energy if energy else '') }}

description: Issue #6 (2026-10-20). One push at input_datetime.house_briefing_time, only while input_boolean.house_briefing_push is on (off by default). It assembles the roll-ups and derives nothing: sensor.any_low_battery, sensor.any_safety_sensor_silent, sensor.lighting_left_on, binary_sensor.climate_health_risk and yesterday's energy digest (input_number.energy_yesterday*). Home's Needs attention shows the same facts on screen.
